description: Acquire one finite count-rate observation for the requested device channels and return normalized counts and rates by measurement reference.
summary: Acquire one finite window of channel counts and count rates.

deviceId.description: Device that acquires the requested count-rate measurements.

resourceDeviceIds.description: Exact lease union: only the TimeTagger when latchGuard is disabled, or that TimeTagger plus every network-resolved detector-health guard when it is required.

items.description: One device needed by this finite acquisition.

channelRefs.description: Unique physical or logical channel references measured in one acquisition window.

items.description: One channel reference accepted by the acquisition device.

durationSec.description: Finite integration duration of the observation window, in seconds.

clear.description: Whether the device clears each measurement accumulation before the window.

latchGuard.description: Explicit finite-window detector-latch policy; disabled permits an unguarded observation, while required validates network-declared detector-health guards and retries only the invalid window.

mode.description: Whether detector-latch validation is disabled or required for this observation.

maxWindowRetries.description: Maximum immediate retries after a recovered detector latch; use zero to reject the first invalid window.

acquisition.countrate.observation.window.description: Normalized context and raw device response for the completed acquisition window.

acquisition.countrate.observation.counts.description: Normalized total counts indexed by measurement reference.

acquisition.countrate.observation.countR.description: Observed count rates in hertz indexed by measurement reference.

acquisition.countrate.status.latchGuard.description: Explicit latch-guard policy, health samples, accepted-window attempt, discarded-window count, and any terminal guard failure.
